title_en: Here's Exactly When You Can Play Phantom Blade Zero Wherever You Live, Along With Preload Details
summary_en: S-Game has finally revealed exactly when you can play Phantom Blade Zero, its upcoming action game with fancy swordplay. Check out the global release times and preload confirmation.
body_en:
S-Game has finally revealed exactly when you can play Phantom Blade Zero , its upcoming action game with graceful, beautiful combat.
Phantom Blade Zero, which features martial arts movie star Donnie Yen, is scheduled for release on October 29, 2026, for PC and PS5, and here’s exactly when you can get your combos in, no matter what platform you play on.
In the meantime, check out the IGN Phantom Blade Zero review . Our 9/10 review called it “an unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger.”
Phantom Blade Zero global release times:
